text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - sudden 503/429 surge in eu-central-1 (gateway cluster). 503s up from ~0.2% -> 6.7% in 3m. Query: dashboards.redwood/prod/errors?panel=503 (alert INC-2371112222)
Maya K: oncall here. paging @Liam O @Ryan Chen. quick snapshot: request queue depth spiking, upstream model-host pools returning 502/503.
Liam O: looking at traces - a single tenant (tenant-highqps-77) is producing long-running multimodal requests, KV cache miss rate has jumped 6x. also seeing many partial streams that time out.
Ryan Chen: no infra deploys in last 15m per deploy-bot. any config changes or customer rollout?
Maya K: not that I can see. initial plan: 1) throttle tenant-highqps-77 with a temporary hard cap, 2) divert new streaming traffic to a standby inference pool (cold pool) and 3) disable experimental-streaming-v2 in eu-central-1.
SRE-Bot: runbook suggestions: apply tenant cap, enable prefix hot-cache, reduce max_concurrency on gateway pods, add 429 fallback to streaming endpoints.
Liam O: applying throttle - command:
```
redwoodctl tenants quota update --tenant tenant-highqps-77 --qps 8 --mode hard --reason "emergency eu-central mitigation"
```
Liam O: applied. verify:
```
redwoodctl tenants quota get --tenant tenant-highqps-77
```
Liam O: shows qps=8 hard.
Ryan Chen: toggling ff:
```
ffctl set --feature experimental-streaming-v2 --env prod --region eu-central-1 --state off --note "emergency mitigation - disable streaming v2"
```
Ryan Chen: flag flipped. also routing change to route streaming -> standby-pool with lower batch-size:
```
routingctl route update --match "path:/v1/stream,tenant=tenant-highqps-77" --backend standby-pool --batch-size 4
```
Maya K: nice. I'll scale up standby-pool capacity by 2 instances to soak diverted load.
Maya K: patching gateway pods to reduce max_concurrency to 32 to prevent head-of-line blocking: `kubectl patch deploy gateway-eu --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"32"}]}]}}}}'`
Jess Torres: pinging customer ops to prepare a heads-up for tenant-highqps-77's account team. drafting note in #customer-impact-drafts.
Emma Patel: support draft: "We detected elevated 5xx rates affecting a portion of EU traffic tied to high-volume requests from your tenant. Temporary throttling and feature adjustments are in place to stabilize service. We'll follow up with a timeline and any required actions."
Maya K: metrics after initial changes: 503s down to 2.0% in 2m, 429s rose to 1.7% (expected due to throttling). p95 latency for gateway decreased 380ms -> 130ms.
SRE-Bot: automated checks: upstream host 95th lat improved and error rates decreased. scheduled re-eval in 10m. alert suppression for this incident enabled.
Liam O: adding an allowlist for control-plane ops to bypass soft caps temporarily (only for health-checks). command: `redwoodctl allowlist add --entity control-health --tenant tenant-highqps-77`
Ryan Chen: logs show KV create storms. I'm enabling short-term prefix hotlist caching for the tenant keys: `kvcachectl hotlist add --tenant tenant-highqps-77 --ttl 600s`
Maya K: good. also enabling a conservative connection pool bump to reduce connection churn: `infractl pool resize --pool gateway-eu --delta +3`
Jess Torres: prepping handoff notes in 20m. if stable, we'll plan to gradually raise qps after 30m of steady state.
Emma Patel: created support case: https://support.internal/redwood/cases/67890 - adding customer ops language and estimated timeline.
Maya K: request: whoever picks up handoff please include exact commands run, runbook link, and dashboard snapshots. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/traffic-mitigation
Liam O: creating TASK-4790 for follow-up engineering work: investigate long multimodal ops and implement per-prefix TTL heuristics. LINK: https://tasks.internal/redwood/TASK-4790
Ryan Chen: monitoring now - kv miss rate falling, upstream 5xx trending down.
Maya K: current snapshot at 2371114088: 503 = 0.9% , 429 = 1.5% , p95 = 120ms. holding for 20m observation window.
SRE-Bot: scheduled check in 15m; will alert if 503 > 1.5% or p95 > 250ms.
Jess Torres: handoff prep:
- incident id: INC-2371112222
- root start ts: 2371112222
- mitigation actions: hard qps cap=8 for tenant-highqps-77, experimental-streaming-v2 disabled in eu-central-1, streaming routed to standby-pool with batch-size=4, gateway max_concurrency set to 32, kv hotlist TTL=600s, allowlist for control-health checks
- dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/eu/503-trends , https://dashboards.redwood/prod/qps-by-tenant
- runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/traffic-mitigation
- follow-ups: TASK-4790 (investigate multimodal spikes), infra task to tune KV cache defaults
Jess Torres: I'll own the active monitoring and will do the handoff in 25m if still active.
Maya K: team - please add any customer-impact notes to the support case. Leaving channel as observe-only for now. :eye:
Jess Torres: taking over. last update at 2371114788. will post final resolution and PM stub once we confirm stable for 1h.
